name: Miyakaze Yuuri
source:
[url=/c50107]Shun's[/url] long-time friend, and the only daughter of a family whom runs a condominium. She suffers from an incurable disease, but that doesn't stop her from living her daily life.

She likes to think of herself as a delinquent, but serves on the Disciplinary Committee since she isn’t the type who can turn down a request.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1113]MangaGamer[/url]]
